intro.text: A skaa slave on Lord Devinshae's plantation, loved by Dockson.

items.text: Dockson slipped between the skaa hovels after dark, braving the mists, to be with her, while other skaa hid the pair from the taskmasters. Their romance gave the plantation's skaa hope and helped them overcome their fear of the mists.

One night Lord Devinshae took her, and she was killed, as the law required of a noble, so that no half-blood Allomancers would be born. She was buried the next morning, and Dockson, unable to stay near her family and Devinshae, left that same day.
